markdown.description: The full formatted answer to show the user, exactly as it would otherwise be written in plain text/markdown.

options.description: One entry per real, distinct bookable candidate this response actually found (e.g. each restaurant in a food comparison, each ride category, each product listing) - so the user can choose between them, not just get a single auto-picked winner. Empty array if this response isn't a bookable comparison. List every real candidate you found, most relevant/cheapest first, up to 5.

label.description: Short human-readable label for this specific option, e.g. 'Bhagatram Sweets - Paneer Butter Masala Combo (₹130)' or 'Uber Auto (₹245)'. This is what the user sees on the button.

direct_url.description: The EXACT url field already present in the MCP tool's own JSON result for this specific item (e.g. its swiggy_url, zomato_url, product url, restaurant url) - copy it verbatim, do not invent one. Omit entirely if the tool result didn't include a real url for this item.

query.description: Fallback only, used when direct_url is not available: the product/restaurant/dish name to search for on the provider's own site.

pickup.description: For ride providers only: the pickup location.

drop.description: For ride providers only: the destination.
